kind: Bài nói trước lớp về bố đổi nghề
L: Today I'd like to talk about my dad and his job.
For fifteen years, he was a taxi driver in Hanoi.
He worked long hours, and he was often tired when he came home.
Last year he decided to change his life.
He had always dreamed of opening a small noodle shop.
My mom helped him, and our whole family worked hard to get it ready.
Now he gets up at five every morning to make the soup.
He still gets tired, but he says he has never been happier.
I'm proud of him, and I hope to be as brave as he is one day.

exq.q: What was the speaker's father's job before?
